newsitem.title: USA: NYC unemployment slips to 9.6 pct in July - city.
newsitem.headline: NYC unemployment slips to 9.6 pct in July - city.

text.p: New York City unemployment, seasonally adjusted, slipped to 9.6 percent in July from 10 percent in June, the city Comptroller's Office said Tuesday.
About 9,100 jobes were created in July, roughly 7,600 in the private sector, the office reported.

The trade sector saw the largest increase, with 2,700 jobs created, mostly in the retail sector. And finance, insurance and real estate (FIRE) saw a gain of 1,000 jobs, mostly on Wall Street. --Reuters Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
